verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Core RESTful API for programmatically managing Paperspace resources over conventional HTTP requests. It can create machines and is authenticated with team-scoped API keys that admins can revoke. A JavaScript SDK and an official CLI sit alongside it. The OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec at the candidate paths, and the evidence shows little of the API reference's depth. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, evidence of endpoint coverage beyond machine creation, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
